recipeInstructions.name: Mix
text: Mix until no dry flour remains.

recipeInstructions.name: Knead
text: Knead until smooth, elastic and slightly tacky.

recipeInstructions.name: Bench ferment and chill
text: Cover and ferment at room temperature for 45–60 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Shape
text: Cut rings or shape into ropes and join into rings.
Set on parchment squares and refrigerate.

recipeInstructions.name: Proof
text: Proof at room temperature for 2–3 hours, until puffy but not fragile. Avoid leaving out overnight.

recipeInstructions.name: Fry
text: Fry 1½–2 minutes on the first side, then about 1 minute on the second.

recipeInstructions.name: Drain and toss
text: Toss warm doughnuts in cinnamon sugar.
